body.name: P_int_nt
body.def: under \(P_{n,t}^{\mathrm{int}}\), \(Z_1,Z_2,\epsilon_x,\epsilon_y\) are independent \(N(0,1)\), \(X=Z_1+\epsilon_x\), and \(Y=(a_{\mathrm{int}}+t/\sqrt n)Z_2+\epsilon_y\) for \(t\in[-\bar T,\bar T]\); equivalently, \(W_i\sim N(0,\Sigma(a_{\mathrm{int}}+t/\sqrt n))\) with \(\theta_0=0\) and \(\gamma=(0,a_{\mathrm{int}}+t/\sqrt n)^{\prime}\)
